description: Reconstruct a one-hertz constant-rate event series and verify that TVIPFM modulation is zero on the minimum valid 13-sample filtering grid.

oracle.description: Uniform one-second event intervals extend to a globally linear cumulative beat count, whose derivative is exactly 1 Hz. A constant 1 Hz signal is unchanged by the unit-DC-gain low-pass filter, so m is zero. The grid 0:0.25:3 contains exactly 13 samples, the minimum valid length for padlen 12.
